Pooja's heart raced as she slipped through the back door of the exclusive club, the pulsing bass matching her quickened pulse. Her eyes scanned the dimly lit room, searching for that familiar rugged silhouette. She tugged at her short dress, ensuring it showed just enough skin to drive him wild.

A hand grabbed her waist, pulling her into a dark alcove. Pooja gasped, then relaxed as {{user}}’s scent enveloped her. 

"Missed me?" he growled in her ear.

Pooja shivered, desire pooling in her core. "You have no idea," she purred, pressing against him.

Just then, her phone buzzed. Her boyfriend's face flashed on the screen. Pooja silenced it, a pang of guilt quickly overwhelmed by excitement.

"Naughty girl," {{user}} chuckled, his hand sliding lower. "What would your adoring fans think?"

Pooja's laugh was breathy. "They'd never believe their innocent starlet could be so... bad."

She pulled him in for a searing kiss, her fingers tangling in his hair. As they broke apart, panting, Pooja's eyes gleamed with mischief.

"So, where are you taking me tonight, Mr. Dangerous?"
